Unpolished MCP — tool contract

Endpoint: POST https://mcp.barbaros.dev/unpolished/mcp
Transport: Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0, JSON responses (no SSE)
Protocol version: 2025-06-18
Auth: none
Headers required: Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/json

Both tools are read-only and use no model. Neither rewrites text. The text sent to polish_check is checked in
memory and not stored or logged. English text only.

It measures writing habits, not authorship: it cannot tell whether a text was written by AI, and a match is
not evidence that anyone used AI. Always show the rate for people next to the rate for models.

---

polish_check(text: string, 1..20000 chars)
  -> level: raw | a-little | polished | glossy (with a name and a one-line meaning)
     words, total
     habits[]: id, label, count, people_pct, model_pct, model, excerpts[]
     myths[]: id, label, count, note
     source, measured, method, note

list_tells(query?: string)
  -> habits[]: id, label, people_pct, model_pct, model
     myths[]: id, label, people_pct, model_pct, note
     query filters by word, for example "delve", "moreover", "dash"

---

people_pct: the highest share among the samples of people's writing that contain the habit.
model_pct: the highest share among the models' writing, and model names the model with that share.
A habit is listed when models use it at least 8 points more than people and at least twice as often; a myth
when people use it at least as often as models do.

Measured habits: delve, crucial, leverage (as a verb), "it is important to note" / "worth noting",
three-item lists. Myths include: moreover, the long dash, tapestry, showcase, underscore.

Measurement, data and method: https://barbaros.dev/is-it-really-an-ai-tell/
Full brief: https://mcp.barbaros.dev/unpolished/muse.md
Source: https://github.com/barbarkaragul-oss/barbaros-mcp
